tests.description: The properties the CI integration rests on, run against the local CLI build and committed fixtures.

steps.description: A clean page exits 0 so the job stays green.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite check --no-config --root test/fixtures/cite test/fixtures/cite/pages/current.md -f github

steps.description: A changed source exits 1 and emits an ::error workflow command titled with the rule id, pinned to the sentence line.
A moved source is a ::warning and exits 0: warnings never fail the job.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite check --no-config --root test/fixtures/cite test/fixtures/cite/pages/moved.md -f github

steps.description: A moved claim is a ::notice and exits 0: a notice never fails the job either.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite check --no-config --root test/fixtures/cite test/fixtures/cite/pages/claim-moved.md -f github

steps.description: An operational error (no inputs, no config) exits 2, distinct from a finding.
